tiktok.title: Open enrollment tip: the account with a triple tax break 💚
tiktok.description:
Open enrollment tip: the account with a triple tax break 💚

On an HSA-eligible high-deductible health plan? Contributions go in pre-tax, grow tax-free, and come out tax-free for qualified medical expenses. 2027 limits: $4,500 self-only, $9,000 family.

Educational only, not financial advice.

#HSA #openenrollment #personalfinance #moneytips #financialliteracy
